sampling_method: fixed absolute timestamp grid; do not sample by every Nth available dataframe row
selection_rationale: 120 minutes provides the primary trade-off between temporal redundancy and observation density. The phase-robustness audit produced median exact-lag autocorrelation 0.762237 at 120 minutes while retaining 10 percent of the native temporal density. Moving to 180 minutes reduced median autocorrelation only to 0.701552 while reducing temporal density from 10 percent to 6.67 percent.
